text.p: Britain's BZW group, a division of Barclay's Bank plc, said on Monday it was strengthening its investment and corporate banking businesses in India with the appointment of three executives.
Tim Martin, BZW's director of corporate finance in London, has been appointed as head of corporate finance and director, investment banking, based in Bombay, it said in a statement.
Manisha Girotra, a Barclays/BZW employee since 1994, has been promoted to head of investment banking, north India, it said.
Madan Menon, former head of corporate banking for eastern India in American Express Bank, has been appointed director, corporate banking, India it said.

"These three appointments are a futher step in the development of our investment and corporate banking businesses in the region," the group chief executive officer in India, Ajay Sondhi, said in a statement.
